comment: Recorded by ServiceControlRuntimeTests.NativeThermalReapplyVectors; regenerate with OPENBLADE_REGENERATE_NATIVE_THERMAL_REAPPLY_VECTORS set to this directory. Each row creates the thermal convergence context on AC, runs ReconcileStartupProfileAsync and one baseline ObserveAsync, optionally confirms Performance and observes again (drift), seeds the ledger (tombstoned: one Performance tombstone, its terminal result and a spent budget; tombstone: that tombstone and terminal result without the budget; budget: the spent budget alone; inFlight: a Performance reservation with that budget), optionally appends a space to the ledger file (changedOnDisk), latches a pending Performance write confirmation (pending), runs one ReapplyChangedSettingsAsync (sessionChanged makes stillControlsSession false) and records the result, the ledger the store then loads and whether the reapply called any setter.
